Market today: The market is sending mixed signals. While the Dow dropped, warning of broader trouble, specific tech names like Dell are surging on strong AI server demand. Geopolitical tensions add a layer of uncertainty. This divergence means some tech/chip names could still perform, but overall market weakness is a risk.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -58.39% and leveraged. SPAL is also deeply in the red at -38.05% and highly volatile. QQQ, SMH, and QQQI are all on 'TRIM' status. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on how the broader market (Dow) reacts to the Dell AI strength and geopolitical news. Specifically, watch if the AI narrative can continue to lift your chip names despite broader weakness.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged, underperforming positions and be ready to reduce exposure if market weakness persists.
plays: Seriously consider exiting SOXL due to its -58.39% loss, 'SELL' status, and leveraged decay, especially with margin amplifying risk.
Re-evaluate SPAL's 'NEW' status and -38.05% loss; its leveraged nature means quick moves and decay.
Trim QQQ, SMH, and QQQI as indicated by your scanner to reduce broad tech/chip ETF exposure.
